23. SRP — Single Responsibility
Principle

SIMPLE ENGLISH
A module should have one reason to change, associated with one actor or responsibility, not
necessarily just one method.

පුළුවන්. ඒ නිසා වගකීම් Jදක Jවන් කරමු.
Finance changes tax rules; the UI team changes receipt formatting.
After InvoiceCalculator · Before Invoice: tax + print · ReceiptPrinter · Read the diagram: Compare the responsibilities or tradeoffs in each group. · Jකාටස් JදJක් Jවනස සසඳන්න.

class InvoiceCalculator { long total(long cents) { return cents; } }
class ReceiptPrinter { String format(long cents) { return "Total: " + cents; } }
Expected result: Changing receipt text need not change the calculation class.

Q: Does SRP require exactly one method per class?
A: No. Related methods can serve the same responsibility and reason to change.
